description: Faster MultiKendall (exp557 was ~5x slower than flat, mostly checkpoint-recompute + chunk overhead). Same idea (T=8 weightless partial-order tables NAP=48, per-table tau, MLP-aggregated, tied, residual->E) but one-shot forward (mk_v_chunk=0, no checkpoint) + mlp_hidden 16->8. Removes the recompute; the inherent 8x output traffic (per-table [N,V,T] taus) remains. vs flat Kendall K384 (~+0.25 plateau), exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656.
